_doc: THE DRONE SOURCES (DEC-34 · 34b; PLAN.md 10.13; RUNNING_LOG §170): the held sounds the players give the electronics to stretch into drones with his `icy`. One row per input: `name` is the sample's name in the bank (the mic opening is named so) · `inst` the lane's recipe key (sandbox/instruments.js) · `technique` the recipe's technique key on that lane · `key` the MIDI key the note is written on · `label` what it is, in words. `holdS` the note's length; `windowS` the opening's length (it opens `preMs` before the note — the opening's length IS the cap on the sample); `gapS` from one note to the next; `startS` the first note. tools/build_drone_sources.js reads this and writes scores/drone-sources.json; his one pass with the engine up banks the nine. HIS DATA — a key, a technique or a name changed here, then the tool again (--replace), then File ▾ → Reload.
